instruction: Please help me install the Python extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Python extension (ms-python.python) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies the extension is installed by checking if 'ms-python.python' appears in the list of installed extensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter extracts the right state: uses 'code --list-extensions' to list all installed VS Code extensions
Metric logic is correct: 'is_extension_installed' with type='contain' properly checks if 'ms-python.python' appears in the output
Expected value is semantically correct: 'ms-python.python' is the official extension ID for the Python extension
Data flow is correct: command output -> contain check -> pass/fail
No postconfig needed: installed extensions persist after installation
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (Python extension installation)
